items.title: Startup reopens implemented audit items
items.premise: S99 audit items are implemented, but readCommittedGeniusAuthority only recognizes done/shipped, so the fresh S100 startup brief advertises both completed S99 findings as critical open work. The Markdown cache and innovation generator use different completion vocabularies.

L2.recipe: Share exact normalized completion vocabulary across startup, Markdown queue, and innovation audit readers; test mixed and exhausted queues.

L3.recipe: Exercise real startup rendering and queue freshness against implemented fixtures, preserving unknown/blocked/unverified states as open.

items.executionEvidence: Shared exact normalized completion vocabulary across three readers; 17 focused regressions passed; canonical studio shard includes the new contract.

items.category: UX; feedback loop; security of local persistence
items.title: Storage failure traps optional feedback dismissal
items.premise: Real browser reproduction at 1440px and 390px in dark/light: denied storage writes throw on Not now, leaving the modal and focus trap active; imported handler reproduction confirms Escape too.

L1.recipe: Always close the dialog despite a persistence exception.

L2.recipe: Use franchise-scoped page-local suppression when storage is denied; guard unavailable storage without claiming a receipt was saved.

L3.recipe: Cover denied reads/writes, denied global storage getter, missing storage, keyboard dismissal, focus return, repeated prompts, and visible save errors in real browser tests and inspected theme/viewport captures.

items.executionEvidence: 8 playtest-journey tests and 4 browser storage regressions passed; four dark/light desktop/mobile failure captures prove dismissal and focus return.

items.category: Feature depth; progression; gamification; deterministic narrative
items.title: Milestone headlines miss canonical stats and repeat exact thresholds
items.premise: Canonical createZeroedSeasonStats reproduction produces no headlines at QB 4100 yards, RB/WR 1050 yards, DL 10 sacks, or QB 31 touchdowns. QB 30 touchdowns produces duplicate headlines on consecutive calls. yardsLast and sacksLastWeek have no production writer.

L1.recipe: Read canonical totals and recognize overshot thresholds.

L2.recipe: Derive previous-stat crossings and persist season-scoped milestone deduplication through runtime save/load.

L3.recipe: Use canonical stat fixtures and verify overshoot, bye/no-stat week, repeated call, save/load, and new-season behavior without changing simulation outcomes.

items.executionEvidence: 46/46 s4-system tests passed, including canonical threshold overshoots and actual weekly simulation plus snapshot restore.

items.title: Milestone ticker stays hidden despite populated news
items.premise: Real-browser canonical milestone capture timed out: newsTicker contains the generated headline and hidden=false but retains its markup hidden class. renderNewsTicker and both close/keyboard handlers manipulate only the hidden property. No caller removes the class.

L1.recipe: Use the hidden attribute consistently for initial ticker visibility.

L2.recipe: Align CSS with the hidden attribute and prove render, close, keyboard reopen and empty feed.

L3.recipe: Inspect canonical generated milestone headlines at desktop/mobile in both themes and add a real-browser visibility regression.

items.executionEvidence: Real-browser test passed for generated milestone visibility, close, keyboard reopen, empty feed and 44px close target; inspected desktop/mobile dark/light captures.
